notes.title: v1.0.5 Minor fixes
notes.content:
v1.0.5
- Some menu options active with advisor on could lead to a crash.
- Patch notes visualization caused a crash if player had no saves.
- Advisor reactivation now immediately effective.
- Fixed a typo in French version.

notes.title: v1.0.4 August 9th 2022 update
notes.content:
v1.0.4

- Fixed occasional program hang in map generation.
- Redistributing resources made old resource slots unavailable for units.
- Translated map generation texts.

notes.title: Patch notes v1.0.3 Aug 7th 2022
notes.content:
v1.0.3
- Selecting an empty save slot caused a crash.
- Changed green and orange colors.
- Deactivated CTRL for debugging.
- Fixed neighbor unit count for city defense.
- Undoing territory selection set up a future crash.
- Patch notes in Preferences.
